title: The other-checkout guard does not read a read-only command's quoted pattern as shell text
why: The other-checkout guard refused a read-only grep whose quoted pattern held a delete of a parent-folder path (guard.log 06:55 CST Nov 8, lane guard-relative-write-escape). Same root cause as step guard-python-quoted-redirect, which fixes python and node only; perl and ruby have it too. Triage hit it again at 07:00 CST: a quoted heredoc to python3 that held that text in a step note was refused.
note: Done check: red tests where grep, perl and ruby read-only calls, and a quoted heredoc body, pass when a quoted argument holds a parent-folder delete or redirect, and a control where an unquoted write still refuses. Merge after guard-python-quoted-redirect's PR. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Slug from the lane; title by triage.
